urls.rationale: Article 6 (Colorado Sunshine Law, §§ 24-6-101 — 24-6-502) includes Part 3 (Lobbyist Regulation, §§ 24-6-301 to 24-6-309) — the core lobbyist-registration and expenditure-reporting regime — plus Part 1 (Disclosure of Lobbying Practices).

Article 18.5 (Independent Ethics Commission, § 24-18.5-101) establishes the body that enforces lobbying-related gift and disclosure rules under Colo. Const. Amend. 41, cross-referenced by Article 6 Part 3.

Article 18 (Standards of Conduct, §§ 24-18-101 — 24-18-309) houses the gift-ban and ethics provisions cross-referenced by the lobbying chapter; includes definitions and penalties applied to lobbyist disclosure violations.

notes: CO Title 24 'administration/' cluster contains 35 articles. Article 6 is the core lobbying-disclosure chapter (Sunshine Law Part 3). Article 18.5 (IEC) and Article 18 (Standards of Conduct) are the explicit cross-referenced enforcement/definitions support. Each chosen article URL is itself a directory of section leaves at depth 6 (state/year/title/cluster/article/section) — leaf resolution deferred to downstream Phase C section-fetch, consistent with TX_2015 convention where chapter-305/ was a directory-leaf treated as a single proposed URL.
